name: Core log
description: A log recording measurements made on physical core samples retrieved from the wellbore, as distinct from in-situ downhole logging tools.
source_note: Seeded by the sqlflow-logtype pipeline to cover the log source CORE, which the partition's existing LogType reference values do not name.

name: Production logging tool log
description: A log acquired with a production logging tool (PLT) to measure downhole flow, pressure and temperature profiles in a producing or injecting well.
source_note: Seeded by the sqlflow-logtype pipeline to cover the log source PLT.

name: Formation pressure test log
description: A log of formation pressure and mobility measurements acquired with a wireline or logging-while-drilling formation tester tool.
source_note: Seeded by the sqlflow-logtype pipeline to cover the log source PRESSURE.
